title: Bound on Input-Position Growth
statement: Let $R\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\Lambda$ be a set of labels, let $P$ be a counter program over $R$ registers with labels in $\Lambda$, and fix an input bit string $x$. For every abstract state $s$ and every $t\in\mathbb{N}$, the read position after $t$ steps from $s$ is at most its initial read position plus $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $R\in\mathbb{N}$ and $\Lambda$ is a set of labels.
$P$ is a counter program over $R$ registers and labels in $\Lambda$.
An input bit string $x$ is fixed.
replaced:
Let $P$ be a counter program on a binary input $x$, let $s$ be an abstract state
of $P$ in which $\mathrm{pos}(s)$ input symbols have been read, and let
$t \in \mathbb{N}$.  Then after $t$ steps of $P$ on $x$ from $s$ the number of
input symbols read is at most $\mathrm{pos}(s) + t$.
